subject.title: fix(sessions): enforce maxEntries/maxDiskBytes against durable conversation entries

question: Should `session.maintenance.maxEntries` and `maxDiskBytes` be absolute caps that may evict idle durable conversation transcripts, including for existing over-budget deployments after upgrade?
rationale: The patch repairs an unbounded-store condition but deliberately replaces the prior durable-conversation retention behavior under pressure; code and tests cannot determine the intended user-retention contract.

options.title: Adopt hard-cap semantics
options.body: Accept eviction of the oldest idle durable conversations only when a configured enforce-mode cap is exceeded, while retaining the new always-protected and age-pruning guarantees.

options.title: Preserve legacy durable retention
options.body: Keep durable conversations non-evictable by default and decide separately whether an explicit strict-cap mode is worth adding.

recommendation.title: Adopt hard-cap semantics
recommendation.body: Accept eviction of the oldest idle durable conversations only when a configured enforce-mode cap is exceeded, while retaining the new always-protected and age-pruning guarantees.
